component.title: Message
component.purpose: Keep a conversational answer legible, attributable, evidence-aware, and recoverable across the full request lifecycle.

states.description: A complete answer with actor, content, evidence, and actions.
The answer is being prepared while identity and geometry remain stable.
Streaming output is explicitly distinguished from a delivered answer.
The answer is delivered and its verification state is visible.
A failed request preserves context and offers an honest retry.
A recoverable message waits for an explicit retry without losing its draft.

claims.statement: The DOM order follows actor, content, activity, attachments, citations, recovery, actions, and footer so screen-reader reading order matches the visual hierarchy.
Actor identity is named through Avatar while presence remains a separate non-color-only status surface.
Request error and retry states preserve message context and expose a keyboard-operable retry action.
Long content, sources, and action labels reflow without clipping across the declared kits and mobile viewport.
The conversation surface remains readable in light and dark native/compatible kits.
